name: Fukuoka Airport

runway.v: two runways: A 2,800 m and B 2,500 m (B opened 20 Mar 2025)

hours.v: operating hours 24 hours, but the hours of use are 07:00-22:00

curfew.v: flights are used only 07:00-22:00 local (MLIT lists hours of use within the 24-hour operating hours); no flights 22:00-07:00 in practice

slots.v: designated a congested airport under the Civil Aeronautics Act in 2016; slots are allocated through the schedule coordinator
slots.quote: 航空法上の「混雑空港」に指定。以後発着枠配分が発着調整事務局へ。

notes: Read MLIT Civil Aviation Bureau, secretariat material for the 1st Technical Study Committee on Improving Fukuoka Airport's Functions (令和8年9月 / Sep 2026). It does not state whether movements outside 07:00-22:00 are banned or allowed by approval, nor customs hours or business-jet rules. An older MLIT Kyushu bureau study page (pa.qsr.mlit.go.jp) also gives 07:00-22:00 as actual hours of use (not used). The MLIT business-jet procedures PDF could not be fetched (permission not answered).
